stem.text: Which molecule has the largest overall dipole?

A.alt: Two C atoms joined by a double bond, each carrying two Cl atoms, drawn with bonds up and down at each carbon.

B.alt: A C atom double bonded to O on the left, with two H atoms drawn above and below on the right.

C.alt: A C atom double bonded to O on the left, with two Cl atoms drawn above and below on the right.

D.alt: A C atom with a double bond to an O atom on each side, drawn in a straight line.
